title: Unlock
summary: UNLOCK', 1. To unfasten what is locked; as, to unlock a door or a chest. 2. To open, in general; to lay open. UNLOCK your springs, and open all your shades.

inlines.v: UNLOCK', 1. To unfasten what is locked; as, to unlock a door or a chest. 2. To open, in general; to lay open. UNLOCK your springs, and open all your shades.
